# NetNewsWire Themes by thechelsuk

> Ten free, open-source reading themes for NetNewsWire, the RSS reader for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Each theme can be previewed in the browser and added to NetNewsWire in one tap.

Key facts:

- Price: free; MIT License
- Install: select Add theme on the site, or download the theme's zip from the latest GitHub release and open the .nnwtheme file
- Modes: adaptive (follows light/dark), light-only or dark-only
- YouTube videos play inside articles via embed.thechels.uk
- Made by thechelsuk (https://thechels.uk); not affiliated with or endorsed by NetNewsWire

## Themes

- [Claudio](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/claudio.html) (adaptive): Warm charcoal, soft cream, and a hint of clay. A quiet, considered space for long reads.
- [Fresh](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/fresh.html) (light): A bright, easygoing palette inspired by a fresh morning on the web.
- [Guro](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/guro.html) (light): Clean lines, generous breathing room, and a little colour where it counts.
- [Magda](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/magda.html) (dark): A dark, easy-reading theme with custom type and a calm, understated palette.
- [Retro](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/retro.html) (dark): A dark page with unmistakable red type. For readers who like a little edge.
- [thechelsuk](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/thechelsuk.html) (adaptive): A familiar look drawn from thechels.uk, adapting to your device's light or dark setting.
- [Franco](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/franco.html) (adaptive): Claudio's warm editorial feel with a crisp blue accent, adapting to light and dark mode.
- [Micha](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/micha.html) (adaptive): Primary colours, honest geometry and a strong grid. A Bauhaus poster you can read.
- [Maika](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/maika.html) (adaptive): Washi paper, sumi ink and a vermilion seal. Japanese minimalism with room to breathe.
- [Sunjiyo](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/test/sunjiyo.html) (adaptive): A sky that follows the hour each post was published, from dawn light to a crescent moon.

## FAQ

### How do I install a theme?

Select Add theme on any theme to open it in NetNewsWire. You can also download the theme's zip from the latest GitHub release, unzip it and open the .nnwtheme file.

### Are the themes free?

Yes. All ten themes are free and open source under the MIT License.

### Do the themes work in dark mode?

Claudio, Franco, Micha, Maika, Sunjiyo and thechelsuk adapt to your device's light or dark setting. Fresh and Guro are light themes, and Magda and Retro are dark.

### Can I preview a theme before installing it?

Yes. Select a theme's screenshot to open a full live preview of an article, including YouTube embeds and reference links.

### Do YouTube videos play inside articles?

Yes. The themes embed YouTube videos through embed.thechels.uk, which supplies the referrer YouTube requires, so videos play inside NetNewsWire.

### How do I change themes later?

You can switch theme at any time in NetNewsWire's settings.
